<!--
  SETUP, HIDDEN. Physically first so everything below can use `fit`, but shown
  to nobody: the reader-facing version of this call is the mirror chunk in the
  fit section. `purl: false` keeps the fixture machinery out of the companion
  script, which runs the fit for real.
-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| purl: false
#| eval: false
library(bgms)

# Fixture loader, copied verbatim from the guide pages.
resolve_fixture = function(name) {
  input_dir = dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
  candidates = c(
    file.path(input_dir, "..", "fixtures", name),
    file.path(input_dir, "fixtures", name),
    file.path("fixtures", name),
    file.path("..", "fixtures", name)
  )
  hit = candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
  if (is.na(hit)) {
    stop("Fixture not found: ", name, " (searched from ", getwd(), ")")
  }
  hit
}

fit = readRDS(resolve_fixture("<fixture>.rds"))
```

## The fit
